concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-top-up-balance-account-scheduled-top-ups]] — 2026-09-15 Marketplace Configuration API pull-sweep guide for verified-bank, region-gated balance-triggered top-ups; default-active configuration precedes asynchronous transfer/credit outcome.
warnings: Page introduces timing/fixed schedules, but its shown request only specifies schedule.type=balance with a threshold; do not derive fixed-time fields from it (raw lines 19–24, 63–107).
Sweep created/active and top-up initiated do not prove funds credited; transfer/transaction webhooks report later outcome (raw lines 53–59, 463–500).
